line: Write down one good thing that happened today before bed.
paragraph: Two teachers in Florida, Maren and David Douglass, noticed a young girl sitting on the ground at the bus stop near the end of their driveway. They built her a bench so she would have somewhere to sit. The girl was caught on camera doing a little dance when she saw it. A small thing, made from paying attention to what someone else needed. That is the good thing worth writing down.

seed.summary: Florida teachers Maren and David Douglass went viral for some heartwarming acts of kindness shown to a young schoolgirl whose bus stop was assigned to the end of their driveway.
